description: Source code for account report models in an OpenERP/Odoo module, defining classes for account report and report history with associated methods and fields.

classes.name: account_report
classes.description: Model for account report with methods for calculations and search functionalities.

classes.name: account_report_history
classes.description: Model for historical indicator data with calculation of values and view management.

methods.name: _amount_get
methods.description: Calculates various financial metrics like debit, credit, balance, report, and tax code based on expressions.

methods.name: onchange_parent_id
methods.description: Updates the type of report when the parent report is changed.

methods.name: name_search
methods.description: Searches for report records by code or name.

methods.name: _calc_value
methods.description: Calculates the value of a report indicator for a given period.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Creates a database view for report history.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Prevents deletion of report history records.
